messages.subject: q value
parts:
I noticed a weird output from calculateDiffMeth.I wanted to analyze differential methylation form one test and one control sample (without replication). While I as subsetting by q value I notice that all rows have same q value even for those which has high p value  (I copied a section below). I did not have this problem in another set of libraries, so obviously the problem is with the input file or the command. Did you happen to face this type of problem before? Do you have any suggestion how to fix this?

Thanks in advance,
Milan
